notes.title: Dev Update v0.3.0: Seasons, Weather & More!
notes.content:
[h2]🌦️ Weather, Seasons, Crafting & More! 🛠️[/h2][p]Hey survivors,[/p][p]It’s been a while, and I want to start by saying [b]thank you[/b] to everyone who's still with us.[/p][p]Due to some [b]personal life circumstances[/b], I wasn’t able to continue development for a while. But I'm back — and so is the game! We're working hard toward a [b]2025 release[/b].[/p][p]Here's what's new in [b]The Risen Survival v0.3.0[/b]:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🌤️ Dynamic Weather & Seasonal System[/h3][p]A new weather and time system is now live:[/p][list][*][p]Seasons affect [b]temperature[/b], [b]humidity[/b], and [b]crop growth[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Your plants respond to [b]changing conditions[/b], just like your character[/p][/*][*][p]Adapt your survival strategy to the environment![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ Enhanced Crafting System[/h3][p]We’ve completely reworked crafting to encourage [b]exploration[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Discover new materials[/p][/*][*][p]Unlock advanced recipes[/p][/*][*][p]Make exploration and survival more rewarding![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🗺️ World Expansion & Wildlife[/h3][p]We’re actively building a [b]larger, more detailed world[/b] with:[/p][list][*][p]More [b]points of interest[/b] and secrets[/p][/*][*][p][b]New enemies and wild animals[/b] with unique behaviors[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🤝 Co-op Mode – Coming After Release[/h3][list][*][p]A [b]4-player co-op mode[/b] is in development[/p][/*][*][p]Play and survive together in a private lobby[/p][/*][*][p]Planned as a [b]free post-launch update[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you again for your patience and support.
This project means a lot to us here at [b]Black Engine[/b], and we’re excited to share more with you soon.[/p][p]If you haven’t already, please [b]wishlist[/b] the game and follow us on Steam for upcoming updates.[/p][p]🔜 More news, gameplay, and a final release date coming soon![/p]

notes.title: Farming Update 1.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452907/2777f3836df10bff6f68497490210c3995ed42fa.png[/img]

Introducing the highly anticipated farming update to our survival game! Now, players can immerse themselves in the world of agriculture, plant their own crops, and reap the rewards of a bountiful harvest. Cultivate a variety of plants, from staple grains to vibrant fruits and vegetables, as you master the art of farming. With each passing day, witness the growth of your crops until they are ready to be harvested, providing you with essential resources for survival. Embrace the role of a skilled farmer and let the farming update transform your gameplay experience into a flourishing agricultural adventure!
